batch: P1 / T05 — image quality, delivery manifest and legacy history on the shared catalogue
inputs: S09 image quality report and image target review (normal + S12 replay)
S11 legacy text, prompt, quality report, image and delivery manifest review

candidate_budget.note: review defects stop at the candidate and never consume another artifact; recovery replays the same persisted review request

calls.note: counting stubs per scenario; review and replay cases assert producer/reviewer call counts and zero extra image submissions

acceptance.WG3-AC-02: covered for S09/S10/S11: advisory pass/fail/unknown/not_applicable never changes a satisfied blocking gate and cannot rescue a blocking failure
acceptance.WG3-AC-03: covered: unknown rule, illegal evidence, wrong target, contradictory decision and duplicate instance are typed 409 REVIEW_INVALID; producer contract defects remain 502 CONTRACT_ERROR; substantive rejection is 409 REVIEW_REJECTED
acceptance.WG3-AC-12: covered for this batch: report approval may coexist with image failure/unknown while bytes stay denied; delivery approval does not publish; historical targets keep original snapshot isolation; A/B/admin resource matrix denied without bytes

routing.retry_policy: REVIEW_INVALID blocks the stage and preserves the candidate; REVIEW_REJECTED requires user action; only model-call failures are outages

results.resources: no image generation calls; no provider network calls; temp SQLite per case; published byte checks use the local asset route

residual_unknowns: frontend rendering of REVIEW_INVALID/REVIEW_REJECTED copy and typed-reason mapping is #93
S10 recovery has no dedicated S12 branch; a failed prepare_delivery can be re-run because it does not create an approval
